title.narrative: North Macedonia Public Sector Energy Efficiency Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objectives are to: (i) reduce energy consumption in the public sector; and (ii) support the development and implementation of a sustainable financing mechanism for energy efficiency in the public sector.

The original project is to support the renovation of public buildings (central and municipal) through the provision of an IBRD loan through a project implementation unit under the Ministry of Finance. In parallel, technical assistance (TA) will be provided to help design and operationalize an Energy Efficiency Fund (EE Fund) to provide financing on a more sustainable basis. The project will also provide an initial capital of EUR 5 million for the proposed EE Fund. The funds would be used to support EE Fund staff, operating costs, marketing, initial audits/designs, and investments.The Additional Financing will provide a EUR 2.14 million grant from the Western Balkans Investment Framework (WBIF) to cover construction cost overruns, reallocate loan proceeds among project components, and extend the project closing date. There will be no changes to the PDO, scope of the Project, or implementing arrangements.
